+_REACTOR_LOCK = threading.Lock()
+_REACTOR_THREAD_STARTED = False
+_REACTOR_READY = threading.Event()
+
+
+def _ensure_reactor_running():
+    global _REACTOR_THREAD_STARTED
+    if reactor.running:
+        return
+    with _REACTOR_LOCK:
+        if reactor.running or _REACTOR_THREAD_STARTED:
+            return
+
+        def _run_reactor():
+            reactor.callWhenRunning(_REACTOR_READY.set)
+            reactor.run(installSignalHandlers=False)
+
+        threading.Thread(target=_run_reactor, name='treq-reactor', daemon=True).start()
+        _REACTOR_THREAD_STARTED = True
+    _REACTOR_READY.wait()
+
+
+def _treq_headers():
+    return Headers({
+        b'User-Agent': [_REQ_HEADERS_['User-Agent'].encode('utf-8')],
+        b'Accept-Encoding': [_REQ_HEADERS_['Accept-Encoding'].encode('utf-8')],
+        b'Host': [_REQ_HEADERS_['HOST'].encode('utf-8')],
+    })
+
+
+def _fetch_bytes(url):
+    _ensure_reactor_running()
+
+    def _do_request():
+        return treq.get(url, headers=_treq_headers()).addCallback(treq.content)
+
+    return blockingCallFromThread(reactor, _do_request)
